title: Think first
lead: Before asking an AI, write down what you think. Then go to the AI on your own and come back to compare.
openEmpty: No open questions. Next time you're about to open an AI chat, start here.
openRowHint: Your confidence: {{confidence}} of 5 · Tap to close it
closedEmpty: Your closed questions and how close you were will show up here.
newTitle: What were you going to ask?
newLead: Your attempt doesn't need to be right. Trying, even if you fail, already helps you learn the answer.
questionHint: Just as you were going to ask the AI.
questionPlaceholder: For example: how often should you water a cactus?
attemptHint: Write what you know or think. If you know nothing, write where you'd start.
attemptPlaceholder: For example: about once a month, because it can handle drought.
saveNeeds: To save: write the question, your answer, and pick how sure you are.
savedLead: Ask it on your own. When you have the answer, come back and close the question: that's where the learning is.
closeLead: Compare what you thought with what you found.
aiAnswerHint: A summary or the full answer. Pasting is fine here.
learnedHint: In your own words, one or two sentences. This is what you'll be asked later.
makeCardHint: We'll ask you again right before you'd forget it.

calibration.good: Your confidence matched what you knew. Well calibrated.
calibration.under: You knew more than you thought. Trust your first attempt a bit more.
calibration.over: You were surer than you were right. That's exactly what's worth noticing.

notFound: This question is no longer open

result.title: How close were you?

tier.learning: Way off, and now you know

result.calibrationTitle: How sure you were vs. how right
result.cardMade: We made a card from what you learned: we'll ask it again just before you'd forget.
